name: solidjs-components-procurement
description: Procurement on Formbird (fieldtec-web): purchase requests with line items, approvers chosen by amount, quotes compared side by side (three above a threshold), budgets per cost centre with a finance override when a request would go over, orders, receipts and invoice matching, with SolidJS elements for the budget check and the quote comparison, and a demo database. Builds on ../solidjs-components-shared, which provides the line items, the approval chain, attachments (photo capture's document list) and stat tiles.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:browser
